name: Ayman Albarbary
title: Digital marketing and communication specialist
bio_short: Digital marketing specialist and published author with more than a decade of experience. Clients include Google, Microsoft, Reuters, The Economist and Saudi Airlines. Adjunct trainer at PwC Academy. Delivers training in English and Arabic.
bio: Ayman is a digital marketing specialist with more than a decade of experience in digital strategy, social media and online communications. He is the founder and CEO of Digital Marketing Academy MENA and founder of Digital Orks, a digital marketing agency. He has consulted and trained for major brands and institutions including Google, Microsoft, Norton Middle East, Saudi Airlines, Reuters, The Economist and Gulf Intelligence. He is an adjunct trainer at PwC Academy and a certified digital marketing professional (CDMP) through the Digital Marketing Institute.  Ayman also teaches at several UAE universities including Abu Dhabi University, Ajman University and the University of Sharjah, and has trained more than 500 delegates across corporate and academic settings. He is a published author on digital marketing topics and stays current with the rapid evolution of digital platforms, AI tools and online communication practices.  At ISOC, Ayman delivers digital marketing, social media and AI communications programmes. His combination of hands-on consulting experience with global technology brands, academic teaching and agency leadership gives him the ability to make complex digital topics accessible and immediately applicable for professionals at all levels. His bilingual capability in English and Arabic makes him effective across the Gulf region. Ayman is based in Dubai.
